sections.description: The Wellness and Health theme features a clean and organised layout designed to present content in a structured format. It includes a responsive design that automatically adapts to desktops, tablets, and mobile devices, helping maintain a consistent browsing experience across different screen sizes. Flexible homepage sections allow information to be arranged clearly, while widget-ready areas provide space for additional content. Built with modern coding standards, the theme supports compatibility with the latest platform updates and commonly used plugins. Customisation options make it possible to adjust colours, typography, layouts, and headers without requiring extensive coding. SEO-friendly code helps search engines understand website structure more effectively, while translation-ready functionality supports multilingual websites. Navigation menus improve accessibility by organising pages in a logical manner, and cross-browser compatibility helps ensure consistent performance across major web browsers. The theme also works with popular page builders, making layout modifications more convenient. Overall, it combines responsive performance, flexible design options, and organised content management to provide a practical foundation for creating and maintaining a modern website with reliable functionality.
